title: sebastiania corniculata f. longifolia
intro: Sebastiania corniculata f. longifolia, commonly known as Brazilian copaiba balsam, is a plant species native to Brazil, characterized by its resinous properties and uses in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Sebastiania corniculata f. longifolia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sebastiania corniculata f. longifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
